skill_name: Discuss the concept of success from a philosophical perspective.
workflow: From a philosophical perspective, success can be defined as the process of achieving or accomplishing desired goals, regardless of the difficulty or complexity of them. It is about striving to reach a state of excellence or accomplishment in life, whether that be through financial, mental or spiritual achievement.
